title: Five Foot Two, Eyes of Blue
writers: Ray Henderson (music), Sam M. Lewis and Joe Young (lyrics)

evidence.note: Wikipedia states the song (full title 'Five Foot Two, Eyes of Blue (Has Anybody Seen My Girl?)') 'was copyrighted on October 19, 1925' with music by Ray Henderson and lyrics by Sam M. Lewis and Joe Young.
Songwriting-credits site musicanet.org dates Ray Henderson's music and Lewis/Young's lyrics to 1925, agreeing with the copyright year.

famous_use: Gave its name to (and is featured in) the 1952 Universal-International film Has Anybody Seen My Gal?, starring Rock Hudson and Piper Laurie.
